Release candidate. Everything runs on your device; nothing is uploaded.

**Web app** — no download needed: https://app.openphotoid.com

**Android** — `OpenPhotoId-<version>.apk`. On the phone, open the file and allow installing from this source. Debug-signed until the Play listing exists; Play will offer the signed build.

**iPhone and iPad** — `OpenPhotoId-<version>-unsigned.ipa`. Not installable without signing: this is the build the App Store submission is made from. The App Store listing will offer the signed build.

**macOS** — `OpenPhotoId_<version>_aarch64.dmg`. Ad-hoc signed: right-click the app → Open the first time.

**Windows** — `OpenPhotoId_<version>_x64-setup.exe` or the `.msi`. Unsigned: SmartScreen will ask once.

Source, checks and the privacy policy: https://openphotoid.com
